map.物高 24mm 在传感器成像 24mm（APS-C 高）：放大率 M = 1.0: Object height 24mm imaged 24mm on sensor (APS-C height): magnification M = 1.0x (true 1:1 macro); if image height 12mm then M=0.5x.
map.M=1.0、传感器高 24mm：可拍最大物体 = 24mm 充满画面；拍更小需更: M=1.0, sensor height 24mm: largest object = 24mm fills the frame; for smaller, need higher magnification or crop in post.
map.像与物等大，放大率 1.0×；标 微距 的镜头常达 1:1 或更高，普通镜头多在: Image and object same size, magnification 1.0x; macro-labeled lenses often reach 1:1 or higher, normal lenses mostly 0.2-0.5x.
map.受镜头最近对焦距离与光学设计；加近摄环/皮腔可突破但损画质与无限远对焦。: Limited by the lens's minimum focus distance and optical design; adding extension rings/bellows breaks through but hurts quality and infinity focus.
map.微距放大率：放大率 m = 焦距 f ÷ (物距 s − f)（×）；联动量：像: Macro magnification: magnification m = focal length f ÷ (object distance s − f) (×); linked value: image height = m × frame height (mm). Validation: required guards for focal length, object distance and frame height, and the object distance s as a denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the closer the object distance to the focal length the larger the magnification (rising sharply as s approaches f), and magnification is the ratio of image height to frame height.
